text:
sam_sales: FYI customer Xero asked us to onboard an open-financial model and pin a specific version for them in EU + APAC. They want a contract clause for data residency and 99.9% SLA. Is this doable?

alex_product: thanks — can you paste the model id and the exact version they want? also timeline?

sam_sales: model: fin-xor-7b, preferred version: v2.1 (they tested v2.2 but have regressions). timeline: pilot in 6 weeks, GA in 3 months.

jordan_eng: rough immediate concerns: capacity in APAC for a 7B that needs lower latency; v2.1 vs v2.2 binary compatibility depends on tokenizer and kv cache layout. we may need a separate variant build for v2.1.

mari_support: also need to confirm whether the customer will send PII in prompts — affects Private vs Hosted choice. Xero said "sensitive financial metadata" but wants self-serve later.

alex_product: priority wise this looks like a commercial + compliance ask. suggest we treat as P1 intake (sales-driven) but with gated engineering acceptance. can ops support 99.9% for pinned model?

jordan_eng: 99.9% across regions is heavy. for Dedicated or Private yes; Hosted we'd need capacity reservation (dedicated pool) and canary rollouts. estimate: dedicated capacity + HA = ~2 weeks infra work + procurement.

nina_privacy: on residency — EU residency is ok via our EU region + KMS config. APAC is trickier depending on country (they mentioned Singapore). need a DPA addendum and proof of KMS key separation.

sam_sales: customer expects us to provide model pinning and geo locks in contract. they're open to a Dedicated commitment for the pilot.

alex_product: launch criteria proposal: 1) model ingested and validated in EU region 2) v2.1 pinned with compatibility tests (tokenization + sample prompts) 3) latency SLO < 250ms p95 for pilot traffic 4) run privacy/legal DPA + KMS audit 5) docs + SDK example for region pin param.

jordan_eng: technical checklist: - ingest artifacts (weights, tokenizer) - run quantization QA (we prefer q4_0) - build runtime variant for v2.1 - perf benchmark on eu-gpu-prod - autoscaler policy for burst.

mari_support: operational tasks: support playbook, escalation path, how to rollback to fallback model if v2.1 regresses. add sample prompts we'll use for quality monitoring.

alex_product: risks: we might need to refuse pin if v2.1 has security/bug issues. fallback policy: route to v2.2 with automatic quality alerts + customer approval for fallback. need sign-off from legal for DPA.

sam_sales: customer ok with fallback only as last resort. they want explicit change-control emails for any model fallback.

jordan_eng: capacity ask: estimate 2 x A100-equivalent for eu pilot, 1 x for apac dev. cost delta to customer? sales to propose.

alex_product: action items: 1) @jordan_eng scope infra effort + rough ETA (due in 48h) 2) @nina_privacy start DPA checklist + list required artifacts (due 72h) 3) @mari_support draft runbook + rollback steps (due 72h) 4) @sam_sales confirm pilot committed spend and exact APAC country (due 24h). I'll add to product intake board and mark tentative priority P1.

deploy-bot: Added to board: https://boards.redwood.internal/product-intake/1950001111 (status: intake) :white_check_mark:

sam_sales: confirmed APAC country = SG. pilot commit: 3-month Dedicated evaluation (they'll sign if pilot metrics meet SLA).

jordan_eng: noted. I'll spike tokenizer compatibility now and report back with whether v2.1 needs a custom kernel.

alex_product: thanks all — we'll reconvene after the 48h updates. tagging this thread for backlog: /prod-intake P1-commercial xero-fin-xor

mari_support: adding sample prompt set from Xero's QA team into the ticket.

nina_privacy: started DPA draft, will need legal to review e-sign.

sam_sales: great, thanks. :thumbsup:
